assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless albedo / base-color texture for a playable 3D game, square 1024x1024. Dense physically plausible tiny paint chips exposing dull steel, fine rubbed abrasion, subtle brushed metal grain, irregular soot and thin dusty grime, faint warm rust at a few chipped spots. Uniform diffuse flat lighting; no baked shadows, no highlights, no vignette, no directional light, no perspective, no reflections. Perfectly seamless left-right and top-bottom tile. Only the material surface: no rivets, seams, borders, diamond tread, letters, objects, logos, watermark or UI. Full resolution natural microdetail and varied subtle wear, avoid exaggerated cracks or heavy orange rust.
